verdict.rationale: Stripe's own revenue recognition documentation claims automated support for global accounting standards, so the core capability exists as a first-party feature. The evidence is a single tagline, though, and does not show how the specifics of the story are delivered. Missing for 10: explicit ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliance details, deferred revenue schedule generation, audit-ready recognition reports, documentation that recognition derives directly from billing data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Simplify your revenue recognition with automated support for global accounting standards
